data.review_body:
Stop using the spinner to suck in people. 
This entire enticement is a scam that encourages customers to spend their money to win free items which never happens. You receive your "order" for which I had a difficult time recalling that I had ordered. 
Temu also has placed within the items to purchase signs that say "Check out" which I purchased, as I believed would take me to the checkout page. But instead I received and was charged for three metal signs that were printed with the words, "CHECK OUT". 
I admit that I truly believed that I was earning free prizes for a purchases but was instead charged for any item that I indicated as a choice for a prize. 
I was fooled. And I proved myself a fool for falling for this scam.
June 1st - June 20th (approx dates)
data.review_headline: Stop using the spinner to suck  in stupid customers like me
